basic_info.description: From the moment you enter, you're embraced by the warmth of the home. The main level opens to a light-filled living room with custom built-in bookshelves and electric fireplace. The space flows effortlessly into an elegant formal dining room, ideal for hosting holidays or dinner parties. The remodeled kitchen is thoughtfully appointed with stainless steel appliances including Wolf range, and adjoins to a sunny breakfast room. Refinished hardwood floors and classic pocket doors bring timeless character, while a stylish wallpapered powder room adds a playful touch. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite is soaked in morning sunlight and benefits from a remodeled ensuite bathroom with dual sink vanity and walk-in shower.  Two additional bedrooms, both of good size, share a large hallway bathroom with a soaking tub.  The true highlight of the home is the expansive, sun-soaked backyardcomplete with turfed lawn and patio space, ideal for summer BBQs, entertaining, or simply outdoor fun.  An oversized garage provides two-car parking, an EV charger, laundry area, tons or storage, and the potential to expand. This charming home blends everyday comfort with thoughtful updates with incredible walkability to restaurants, shops, markets and parksan Inner Sunset gem not to be missed.
